output.name: Botsmith
output.tagline: Support chatbot that cites sources or escalates — never hallucinates
output.description: Build a support chatbot from your docs in 5 minutes. Every answer cites its source or escalates to a human. 61% of chats resolved end-to-end for Pixelhaven. {APP_URL}
output.first_comment: Hey Product Hunt! We're launching Botsmith — a support chatbot builder that ensures every automated answer is backed by a real document or escalates to a human instead of making things up. We built this because too many bots erode trust by confidently giving wrong answers. With Botsmith, you paste a sitemap URL and get a live widget in about five minutes. The core innovation is our guardrail layer: if the bot can't find a high-confidence answer in your docs, it won't guess — it hands off. 100% of answers include source citations by design. We're live with customers like Pixelhaven, where we resolve 61% of chats without human help. We'd love feedback on the setup flow, escalation logic, and how we communicate trust. What should we add next? (We know: multilingual, voice, deeper security docs.)
